Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Dartmoor (and other loquipments) are equipments while not in play, and are locations while in play.  [LSJ 19971020] .
"Equipment" and "equipment card" are synonyms. I'll add it to the Review, in order to have cardtext coherence.

Regarding the second question: This lapse of time has no name in VTES. Cards use "until your untap phase", mostly.

Messages.Author: Megabaja
Messages.Body:
Yes they are locations while in play, but above example considers type of card ( action, equipment, retainer, reaction) rather then type of equipment ( weapon, location, vehicle). In cases where actions are not supposed to work with loquipments, card text states that clearly. Thats why I bolded Dartmoor text - that text makes difference between equipment and equipment card stating that locquipment stays equipment card type, but loses equipment status. Pnly Living Manse has different type of text.

There are many confusing examples.

Ignorance is bliss.
Cypher, Matrix

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Here's the quote from LSJ I linked above:

> LSJ wrote:
> Loquipment is just equipment when it isn't in play (and is just
> location when it is in play).
>
Dartmoor isn't an equipment while in play. It's a location. (also notice: it isn't an action card neither). You therefore can't burn it with Arcane Apraiser (which can only burn equipments [== equipment cards], not locations.)

Thoughts have been given on this point. Questions have been asked. Rulings have been made. And I'm not going to reverse these antediluvian points.

Ask yourself: do you retrieve the Ankara Citadel when you diablerize the vampire it is on? (answer is: "no"  [LSJ 20030607] )
Can you transfer locations with Heidelberg Castle? (answer is: "no"  [LSJ 20020411] ).

This last post also reads this:

[LSJ 20020411] wrote:
>
> [..] "equipment card" means, for a card in play, a "card that represents equipment".
>
In this game, "represents" (and "is considered as") is an equivalent to "is".
